words: Tier 3 and Tier V players. This SOP covers every VVIP contact.
A player rarely stays on one channel. What he said on Telegram matters on LiveChat, and the other way round.
The link to the player's last Telegram chat. Open it when he arrives on LiveChat.
The link to the player's last LiveChat chat. Open it when he arrives on Telegram.
Where you see the arrival channel and update the player record after each interaction.

tour.label: When
tour.title: Ready to reply to a VVIP?
items: You know which channel the player came from
You opened the other channel's last-chat link
You noted unresolved issues and pending requests
tour.done: Now reply. Inbound or outbound, every brand.
tour.notYet: No reply yet. Read both histories first, whenever both are available.

tour.label: Do
tour.title: Four steps, every VVIP contact
items: Find the arrival channel
LiveChat or Telegram, in the Customer Approaching System.
Open the other channel
LiveChat arrival: Last Telegram Chat Link. Telegram arrival: Last LiveChat Link.
Review the full history
Note unresolved issues and pending requests before you reply.
Update the record
After handling: the outcome and any follow-ups.

tour.label: Crossover
tour.title: Which link to open
items: Arrived on LiveChat
Open the Last Telegram Chat Link.
Arrived on Telegram
Open the Last LiveChat Link.
Both available
Review both.
Click path
Follow the on-screen guide.

tour.label: Never
tour.title: Four hard stops
items: Reply to or contact a VVIP before checking the history.
Ask the player to repeat information he already gave.
Read only the arrival channel when both histories are available.
Leave the player record without an update after the interaction.

tour.label: Ask or not
tour.title: Before you ask the player anything
tour.q: Is the answer already in his LiveChat or Telegram history?
tour.yes: Use it. Never ask him to repeat it, and follow up on anything still open.
tour.no: Ask, then update the player record after the chat.

pool.q: A VVIP messages you on LiveChat. Before your first reply, which link do you open?
pool.why: Scenario 1: LiveChat arrival, open the Last Telegram Chat Link so nothing raised on Telegram is missed.

pool.q: A VVIP messages you on Telegram. Which history do you also review?
o: His LiveChat history, through the Last LiveChat Link
pool.why: Scenario 2: Telegram arrival, open the Last LiveChat Link.

pool.q: You are about to send a VVIP an outbound message. Do you check his history first?
o: Yes, every VVIP interaction, inbound or outbound
pool.why: Scope and Remarks: the check applies to all inbound and outbound VVIP contact.

pool.q: His Telegram history shows he already explained his issue yesterday. Now he is on LiveChat. What do you do?
o: Ask him to explain again from the start
Pick up from what he said; never make him repeat it
Tell him to go back to Telegram
pool.why: Golden Rules: never ask a player to repeat information he already provided.

pool.q: The LiveChat history shows a request from last week that nobody answered. What now?
o: Follow up on it in this chat
Ask him whether he still cares
pool.why: CS Responsibilities: follow up on unresolved issues and pending requests.

pool.q: You finished handling a VVIP. What is the last step?
o: Update the player record with the outcome and follow-ups
pool.why: Step 4: update the player record in the Customer Approaching System after every interaction.

pool.q: When do you review the conversation history?
o: Only at the end of the shift
pool.why: Golden Rules: review the history before replying to any VVIP player.

pool.q: Both histories are available but the queue is busy. What does the SOP say?
o: Ask a teammate to read them later
pool.why: Golden Rules: review both LiveChat and Telegram history whenever both are available.

pool.q: You cannot find where the Last LiveChat Link sits on the screen. What do you follow?
pool.why: Remarks: follow the on-screen guide for the exact click path.
